value.rationale: A complete all-length/all-probability-space sharp Lp norm classification of binary conditional-expectation chains supplies a natural quantitative form of a historical alternating-projection problem. It identifies a structural sharp boundary: Hilbertian time-reversal norm equality holds universally at p=2 but has no uniform counterpart at any other exponent, even on three atoms and for every fixed positive iterate; a four-atom example has exact two-step mixing despite nonzero adjacent correlations. These are motivated operator-theoretic distinctions rather than an arbitrary numerical slice.
